values: Monitoring period dates within Federal FY2025

grounding.excerpt: *10     The limits begin on the effective date of this permit and lasting through 3 years from the permit effective date.

*11     The limits apply during the period beginning 3 year from the permit effective date and lasting through the expiration date of the permit and any time during which the permit is administratively continued if not reissued prior to expiration.

payload.rationale: The obligation demands determining whether footnote *10 (not *11) governs Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase limits for monitoring periods within Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30). The packet supplies the mutually exclusive temporal rules for footnotes *10 and *11, both anchored to the permit effective date, but does not state the permit effective date or any Federal FY2025 monitoring-period dates. Without both anchors, neither ACCEPT (establishing that *10 applies to those periods) nor REJECT (establishing that *10 does not apply and *11 does) can be grounded. The packet's known_missing_information also notes it may be evidence-insufficient. Uncertainty is left explicit rather than closed by absence.
